en.headline: Education Bureau releases primary information and innovation technology curriculum
en.dek: All primary schools will introduce the new subject from the 2028/29 school year, covering five strands including programming and artificial intelligence, and it will not count toward secondary places allocation.
body: The Education Bureau on Friday published the draft curriculum framework for Primary Information and Innovation Technology, to be implemented across all primary schools from the 2028/29 school year.

The curriculum covers five learning strands: information technology concepts and applications, computational thinking and programming, preliminary study of artificial intelligence, basic engineering and robotics-related technologies, and technology and society. The subject will not be included in the internal assessment used for secondary school places allocation.

The bureau said the subject is intended to provide a better interface with secondary technology education and responds to the direction in the 2026 Policy Address to review primary technology education and promote digital and STEAM education. Schools are encouraged to begin planning and piloting the curriculum as soon as possible.
A pilot version of the artificial intelligence strand was released in July for early reference by schools.

zh.headline: 教育局公布小學資訊與創新科技課程框架
zh.dek: 全港小學將於2028/29學年起推行新科目，涵蓋編程及人工智能等五個範疇，不納入呈分試。
body: 教育局周五公布《小學資訊與創新科技課程框架（擬定稿）》，全港小學將於2028/29學年起推行該科。
課程涵蓋五個學習範疇：資訊科技概念與應用、計算思維與編程、人工智能初探、基礎工程與機械人相關技術，以及科技與社會。該科不納入用於中學學位分配的校內成績評估。
教育局表示，新科目旨在更好銜接中學科技教育，並回應2026年施政報告檢視小學科技教育、推動數字及STEAM教育的方向。當局鼓勵學校盡早規劃及試行課程。
人工智能初探範疇的試行版已於7月發放，供學校參考。
